title: 8.1 Measures of Center and Variation

icans: I can find and interpret the mean, median, and mode of a data set.
I can explain how an outlier affects the measures of center.
I can find the range and describe how changing every value changes the measures.

vocab: one number that ____________ the center of a data set: the mean, median, or mode
the sum of the values __________ by the number of values
the __________ value when the values are in order (the mean of the two middle values when there is an even number)
the value or values that __________ most often (there may be no mode)
a value that is much __________ or much less than the other values
a number that ____________ the spread of a data set
adding the same number to, or ______________ by the same number, every value

blocks.p: Hours of sleep last night for 10 students:   6, 7, 7, 8, 5, 7, 9, 6, 8, 7
Then an 11th student who slept 18 hours joins the data.
Which measure changed the most? Which number best describes a typical student now? Why?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem: Quiz scores: 82, 90, 75, 90, 88, 79. Find the mean, median, and mode.
The mean of 12, 15, 9, x, and 14 is 13. Find x.

notes: Outliers: An outlier pulls the _______________ toward it. With an outlier, the _______________ usually describes the center better.

blocks.stem:
Commute times (minutes): 24, 27, 25, 26, 23, 25, 60.
a.  Find the mean and median with the outlier.
b.  Find the mean and median without the outlier.
c.  Which measure better describes a typical commute?

Points scored in 6 games:
Player A:  14, 20, 18, 22, 16, 18
Player B:  8, 30, 12, 26, 20, 12
Find the mean and range for each player. Compare.

notes: Data transformations: Add k to every value: the center goes up by ______ and the range _______________. Multiply by k: every measure is _______________.

blocks.stem:
The data 4, 7, 7, 10 have mean 7, median 7, mode 7, and range 6. Find the mean, median, mode, and range when
a.  5 is added to each value.        b.  each value is multiplied by 2.
The mean of 7 test scores is 81. Six of the scores are 78, 85, 80, 74, 90, and 79. Find the seventh score.
Test scores: 70, 75, 82, 85, 88. The teacher adds 4 points to every score. Find the new mean, median, and range.

tickets.stem: Find the mean, median, and mode of 5, 9, 3, 9, 4.
Which measure of center is affected the most by an outlier?
